title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode7 Thoughts That Go Into a Song

meta.Episode: Episode7 — Thoughts That Go Into a Song
meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Would you mind telling me more about the music you make, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me...?
Sure, but what do you want to know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Your creative process, for example...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My creative process...? I'm not sure how to answer that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Usually, a melody just pops into my head and I start writing down the music for that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once I have something substantial, I'll try adding in some instruments and making adjustments based on that. Afterwards, it's just rinse and repeat...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you have any specific advice regarding how to go about that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, my guess is that Kanade doesn't really think about composing in such a structured fashion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
R-Right...
I'm sorry. I really don't know how to put my process into words.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, what if I asked this instead...?
How or when do these melodies pop into your head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't point to a specific time or thing, but I do know that I require some sort of inspiration to begin composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like I'm able to compose good songs when they're based on past memories or something someone said...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
For example, in my case...
It may be trying to make someone smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You just said that you want your songs to touch people's hearts, right, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it's similar to that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I understand a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I can't help but feel surprised. I knew that you composed your own music, Ms. Yoisaki, but it's really hard not to be impressed by what you do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And those lyrics...!
They really struck a chord with me.
Did you write those too, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She did.
Mafuyu definitely has a way with words, so we've asked her to write all of our lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That means a lot coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm only able to write lyrics like that because your songs are so good, Kanade. All I'm doing is trying to match the atmosphere you're trying to create.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So really, these lyrics aren't anything special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still... Your lyrics make it so clear as to how you feel, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they go perfectly with Yoisaki's music, but it's also a clear expression of how you feel, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it, but your lyrics really resonate with me...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see. This must be a first in terms of my lyrics...
Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is nothing like the music I created as OWN.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Whenever I listen to OWN's music, I feel like I'm being sucked into some other place.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <There's something wrong with whoever made these. I wonder who it is.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Listening to these makes me want to disappear, but I just can't seem to stop. So strange.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Back then, I didn't care one bit about how anyone felt when they heard those songs.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was just trying to find the real me, and churning out music that reflected what I was feeling then.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even now, I don't know how I'm supposed to feel. All I'm really doing is listening to Kanade's songs and writing lyrics that match them... Or so I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That time when Kanade's song made me smile, I actually felt like expressing myself more through my lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I wanted more people to hear it, or at the very least, for it to not go unheard...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Do my lyrics really carry any meaning...?)
